_comment: SSC product data for advisor system prompts. Keep in sync with js/data.js and _includes/modals/sauna.njk when pricing or models change. Price sheet version 4 (catalogue restructure, 2026-08-03) -- these are the prices the configurator quotes. The base price buys a COMPLETE sauna: a standard heater, electric or wood-fired where offered, is included at $0 and no add-on is ever required to make the build work. Delivery is not quoted; it is arranged at order.

s2.name: S2
s2.description: Compact sauna for couples or small spaces. Electric heater only.

s4.name: S4
s4.heater: Harvia M3 or Homecraft 7.5kW (wood-fired or electric)
s4.description: Most popular residential model. Fits families and small groups.

s6.name: S6
s6.heater: Harvia M3 or Homecraft 7.5kW (wood-fired or electric)
s6.description: Great for entertaining. Room for larger groups with full bench layouts.

s8.name: S8
s8.heater: Harvia M3 or Homecraft 7.5kW (wood-fired or electric)
s8.description: Large residential or small commercial. Major gathering space.

sc.name: SC
sc.heater: Harvia Pro 20 or Homecraft Revive 9kW (wood-fired or electric)
sc.description: Commercial-grade. Custom dimensions available. Built for high-traffic venues.

options.name: Standard wood-fired heater, Harvia M3 (included, S4/S6/S8)
options.note: No standard wood-fired build on S2 (clearances) or SC (commercial spec).

options.name: Original-IKI Wood-fired (SC)
options.note: Priced over the standard ELECTRIC stack, because SC has no standard wood build -- which is why it costs more than S6/S8 despite the same stove.

options.name: Trailer integration
options.note: Integration labour only, flat on every model. The trailer is client-supplied; if SSC sources one it is quoted separately by final box length.

options.name: 2' semi-enclosed deck (two finished side walls, covered roof)
3' semi-enclosed deck (two finished side walls, covered roof)

premiumFinishPackage.note: Bundles clear cedar interior + cedar exterior + WiFi + interior/exterior lighting + the STANDARD Bluetooth speaker set. Saves $500 vs selecting those five individually. Premium audio is not in the package.

additionalOptions.name: Premium audio (Polk Atrium 5 all-weather pair + 2.1 Bluetooth amp)
additionalOptions.note: Mounted outside the peak-heat zone; placement confirmed at consultation.

construction.foundation: Open deck flooring for ventilation and drainage. Place on packed gravel, concrete feet, or pavers.
construction.electricalCert: Third-party electrical certification included on all wired saunas

payment.structure: 30% deposit / 30% at halfway / 30% near completion / 10% on delivery

timeline.note: Timelines vary depending on project complexity and current workload

serviceAreas.primary: Sea-to-Sky corridor, Greater Vancouver, Fraser Valley
serviceAreas.extended: BC-wide and beyond (Williams Lake, Edmonton, San Francisco completed)
serviceAreas.note: Contact us to discuss logistics for locations outside our primary area
